title: Olivia Rodrigo's New Tour Started With a Dress That Dissolves and a Birthday Surprise
summary:
Have you ever been to a concert where flowers grow on stage and a dress melts away? That's what happened at the first night of Olivia Rodrigo's new Unraveled Tour.

The show started in Hartford, Connecticut. Olivia rose up from a field of wildflowers on the stage floor. Pink and white flowers were everywhere — so many that stagehands kept replacing them as they got knocked around.

Olivia played songs from all three of her albums. She sang hits like "Drivers License" and "All-American Bitch." There was rain, snow, and confetti falling from the sky. Fans wore light-up bracelets that made the arena look like a starry night.

One of the coolest moments? Olivia sat down at a piano and asked the whole crowd to sing "Happy Birthday" to her mom, Jenny. "She's the best mom a girl could ever ask for," Olivia said. "I would not be here without her."

Olivia also surprised fans by appearing on three different stages — a big curved one, a small round one, and a tiny one just for her. She walked along the barricade, holding hands with fans and even posing for a selfie.

The tour is called Unraveled, and it's already a hit. Olivia said, "I can't believe we're here." Neither can her fans!
why_it_matters: It shows how a concert can bring thousands of people together, and how even a famous star remembers the family member who helped her get there.
